Prioritize changes that may reduce timed scratch or mode-transition cost while preserving the four-tile FP32 kernel. Then test focused scheduling and address changes with limited correctness risk. Rank added packing, copy traffic, or abandoning SME lower because their setup cost or lost MOPA throughput may outweigh any benefit. This order is a proposal for serial AC measurements, not a claim of speedup.
